title: Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann: Parallel Works
native: グレンラガン パラレルワークス
synopsis:
An anthology of animated shorts featuring characters from Gurren Lagann in alternative worlds. Every clip is animated by a particular animator of GAINAX.

Creators are Akira Amemiya, Shin Itagaki, Hirokazu Kojima, SUEZEN, Ryouji Masuyama, Hiroyuki Yamaga, Yoh Yoshinari, and Keisuke Watanabe

episodes.title: BafBaf! Do You Like Being That... Fired Up!!
episodes.synopsis: Viral encounters a pachinko Gunmen, and then unleashes it on Kamina, Yoko and Simon.

episodes.title: Boing vs Boing
episodes.synopsis: A version of the series in an artistically-stylized medieval Japan setting.

episodes.title: Rap is a Man's Soul! Open Your Ears Wide and Listen to the Great Kamina's Theme, the Man Who Believes in Himself and Surges at Heaven!
episodes.synopsis: A nude Gimmy steals articles of clothing from Simon, Kamina and Yoko using kancho.

episodes.title: To Hell With Gattai!
episodes.synopsis: In a modern-looking alternate setting, humans pilot Lagann and Gurren against Beastmen-like enemies in Gunmen and then team up with other humans against a Dai-Gunmen.

episodes.title: Libera Me From Hell
episodes.synopsis: An experimental real world look at the environment of the surface portrayed in the first half of the series, which includes the shadow of a man running and a skull motif, possibly in reference to Kamina's father.

episodes.title: All You Bastards, Get Fired Up!
episodes.synopsis: The story of Lordgenome's past, with the first war against the Anti-Spirals, Lordgenome's descent into madness and the rise of the Beastmen.
